question: Who among the following was appointed as Minister of Health and Family Welfare in June 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __J. P. Nadda__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• J. P. Nadda:

 
 
• J. P. Nadda served as the Minister of Health and Family Welfare in the Government of India.
 
• He was appointed to this position in November 2014 during the first term of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.</li&
